title: Kaltura Experience Components Catalog
description: A2UI catalog for Kaltura Experience Components: Player v7, Flashcards, Media Manager, and more. Freestanding schema with all types inlined. Lists the A2UI basic components and functions (copied from the A2UI basic catalog), the Kaltura components and the Kaltura function copyToClipboard. A surface uses one catalog, so register only this one.

x-kaltura-adapters.description: Where tier-1 A2UI clients can load the renderers backing this catalog's components. Served by jsDelivr from the git tags of github.com/kaltura/kaltura-a2ui-components. Not on npm. In source, the tag and the SRI hashes are placeholders. The release workflow fills them in and commits the result only in the release commit the tag points to.

react.description: ESM bundle. React is an external peer. The host provides it. Register kalturaReactCatalog alone (see buildKalturaCatalog). It already holds the basic components. The module imports a second file, the SSR stub at stubCdn. Pin it with stubIntegrity too.

webcomponent.description: Self-contained IIFE (React inlined, CSS-in-JS). Drop in via <script> on plain-HTML hosts; registers all Kaltura custom elements on load. Verify with the integrity hash.

KalturaPlayer.description: Plays one entry with the player (uiConf) the host allows.

uiconfId.description: Player (uiConf) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding.

entryId.description: Entry ID to play, a string like '0_abc123'.

autoplay.description: Auto-start playback. Requires muted=true per browser policy. Default: false.

muted.description: Start muted. Must be true when autoplay is true. Default: false.

startTime.description: Seek to this position (seconds) on load.

entryName.description: Optional entry name shown in the player title.

entryDescription.description: Optional entry description shown under the player. HTML tags are stripped.

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

KalturaFlashcards.description: A deck of study cards. Each card can have video clips. The cards are literal: to change them, send the component again.

uiconfId.description: Player (uiConf) ID used to play the clips. Integer, not a string, not a binding.

summary.description: Brief summary or description of the flashcard deck.

cards.description: Ordered list of cards. Literal only, no data binding: to change the cards, send the component again.

clips.description: Video clips relevant to this card.

thumbnail.description: Optional thumbnail URL for the clip.

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

KalturaMediaManager.description: Library browser for the account's media. In 'select' mode the user picks entries and the action gets their IDs. 'manage' mode is the full content manager.

partnerId.description: Kaltura partner (account) ID. Integer, not a string, not a binding.

serverUrl.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the Unisphere host of the app's region. Otherwise a Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

theme.description: UI theme mode. Default: the host page's data-theme attribute, else 'dark'.

mode.description: Interaction mode. 'select' for content picking, 'manage' for full CRUD operations. Default: 'select'.

multiSelect.description: Allow picking up to 5 entries. Default: false.

contextId.description: ID of the content scope (e.g. category ID to browse).

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

reportType.description: Dashboard view to show when there is no entryId. One of engagement, content-interactions, technology, geo-location, contributors, overview, publisher, enduser or live. Default: engagement.

fromDate.description: Start of the date range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Needs toDate. Default range: the last 30 days.

toDate.description: End of the date range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Needs fromDate.

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

KalturaChart.description: Kaltura Chart: 12 chart types (line, bar, area, pie, scatter, geo, wordcloud, treemap, heatmap, radar, sankey, funnel). The data is literal: to update the chart, send the component again.

chartType.description: Chart type. It sets how rows are read. line, bar, area, scatter, radar: xKey is the category, yKeys are the numeric series. pie, treemap, funnel, wordcloud, geo: yKeys[0] is the value, and rows with a value of 0 or less are dropped (wordcloud draws the top 80). geo: xKey is a country name or an ISO alpha-2 code. sankey: one row per link, xKey is the source and yKeys is [target, value]. heatmap: one row per cell, xKey is the column and yKeys is [value, row].

data.description: Rows to draw, as objects. Literal only, no data binding: to update the chart, send the component again. At most 500 rows are drawn. Row shape depends on chartType.

sourceData.description: Full dataset for table/export view when chart shows a summary subset.

title.description: Chart title displayed above the visualization.

xKey.description: Key of the x-axis or category value in each row. Default: 'name' (pie), 'text' (wordcloud), 'country' (geo), 'source' (sankey), else the first key with a non-number value.

yKeys.description: Keys of the value series. Default: every key except xKey. For pie, treemap, funnel, wordcloud, geo, sankey and heatmap the order matters. See chartType.

yLabels.description: Human-readable labels for the yKeys series (legend labels).

colors.description: Optional color overrides for chart series (hex or CSS color strings).

annotations.description: Vertical annotation markers on cartesian charts (line, bar, area, scatter).

color.description: Annotation color (hex or CSS). Default: accent color.

action.description: Optional. Tells the agent about this widget's errors and events, with fixed fields only (never the KS or remote text).

required.description: Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

regex.description: Checks that the value matches a regular expression string.

formatString.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and client-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.

formatNumber.description: Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatCurrency.description: Formats a number as a currency string.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatDate.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

format.description:
A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

Token Reference:
- Year: 'yy' (26), 'yyyy' (2026)
- Month: 'M' (1), 'MM' (01), 'MMM' (Jan), 'MMMM' (January)
- Day: 'd' (1), 'dd' (01), 'E' (Tue), 'EEEE' (Tuesday)
- Hour (12h): 'h' (1-12), 'hh' (01-12) - requires 'a' for AM/PM
- Hour (24h): 'H' (0-23), 'HH' (00-23) - Military Time
- Minute: 'mm' (00-59)
- Second: 'ss' (00-59)
- Period: 'a' (AM/PM)

Examples:
- 'MMM dd, yyyy' -> 'Jan 16, 2026'
- 'HH:mm' -> '14:30' (Military)
- 'h:mm a' -> '2:30 PM'
- 'EEEE, d MMMM' -> 'Friday, 16 January'

pluralize.description: Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback. For English, just use 'one' and 'other'.

value.description: The numeric value used to determine the plural category.

two.description: String for the 'two' category (used in Arabic, Welsh, etc.).

few.description: String for the 'few' category (e.g., small groups in Slavic languages).

many.description: String for the 'many' category (e.g., large groups in various languages).

other.description: The default/fallback string (used for general plural cases).

openUrl.description: Opens the specified URL in a browser or handler. This function has no return value.

and.description: Performs a logical AND operation on a list of boolean values.

values.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

or.description: Performs a logical OR operation on a list of boolean values.

values.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

not.description: Performs a logical NOT operation on a boolean value.

copyToClipboard.description: Copies the text to the clipboard. Does nothing for empty text. This function has no return value.

text.description: The text to copy to the clipboard.

ComponentId.description: The unique identifier for a component, used for both definitions and references within the same surface.

AccessibilityAttributes.description: Attributes to enhance accessibility when using assistive technologies like screen readers.

label.description: A short string, typically 1 to 3 words, used by assistive technologies to convey the purpose or intent of an element. For example, an input field might have an accessible label of 'User ID' or a button might be labeled 'Submit'.

description.description: Additional information provided by assistive technologies about an element such as instructions, format requirements, or result of an action. For example, a mute button might have a label of 'Mute' and a description of 'Silences notifications about this conversation'.

oneOf.description: A static list of child component IDs.
A template for generating a dynamic list of children from a data model list. The `componentId` is the component to use as a template.

path.description: The path to the list of component property objects in the data model.
A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.

DynamicValue.description: A value that can be a literal, a path, or a function call returning any type.

DynamicNumber.description: Represents a value that can be either a literal number, a path to a number in the data model, or a function call returning a number.

DynamicBoolean.description: A boolean value that can be a literal, a path, or a function call returning a boolean.

DynamicStringList.description: Represents a value that can be either a literal array of strings, a path to a string array in the data model, or a function call returning a string array.

FunctionCall.description: Invokes a named function on the client.

call.description: The name of the function to call.

returnType.description: The expected return type of the function call.

CheckRule.description: A single validation rule applied to an input component.

message.description: The error message to display if the check fails.

Checkable.description: Properties for components that support client-side checks.

checks.description: A list of checks to perform. These are function calls that must return a boolean indicating validity.

Action.description: Defines an interaction handler that can either trigger a server-side event or execute a local client-side function.

event.description: The event to dispatch to the server.

name.description: The name of the action to be dispatched to the server.

context.description: A JSON object containing the key-value pairs for the action context. Values can be literals or paths. Use literal values unless the value must be dynamically bound to the data model. Do NOT use paths for static IDs.

CatalogComponentCommon.description: Catalog-level properties shared by all Kaltura components.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

primaryColor.description: The primary brand color used for highlights (e.g., primary buttons, active borders). Renderers may generate variants of this color for different contexts. Format: Hexadecimal code (e.g., '#00BFFF').

iconUrl.description: A URL for an image that identifies the agent or tool associated with the surface.

agentDisplayName.description: Text to be displayed next to the surface to identify the agent or tool that created it.
